located_observations.observation: A serving hand grips the spatula handle; the blade visibly supports the green vegetable pancake slice as the other hand supports the receiving plate. No obvious broken ownership or contact was seen.

The picking hand, soundhole, strings, fretboard and chord hand form one continuous guitar action. Strings align through the instrument and the visible hands retain recognizable finger anatomy; no obvious structural defect was seen.

Three casually dressed adults sit together with repeated plain blue reusable cups and food. The dusk cyan, warm light and shared cups connect this crop with serving rather than presenting separate commercial venues.

Food and guitar are the large visual anchors, while the upper-right event title is the first strong text anchor. The date/time in the left cut seam gives the next firm stop; venue/entry sits below identity, food purchase/participation sits at the pan edge, and the cup request and invitation finish the right image junction.

The three large unequal photographic areas are cut together by sloping hard boundaries and unframed overlap. They remain the dominant construction; dark local text knockouts do not form a broad master information panel.

Hangul blocks have consistent proportions and open counters; word gaps remain visible, English capitals are stable, and date/time punctuation is distinct. The time range is optically read with a centered en dash; raster inspection does not certify an underlying Unicode code point.
Cuts between food, social and guitar images are clean. Natural food, wood, skin and evening foliage details remain visible; there are no torn-paper edges, Polaroid frames or taped corners.

substantive_visual.observation: Large nonglyph serving, guitar-playing and adult social-presence photographs actively organize the full composition and communicate the event.

assigned_style.observation: Contemporary editorial photographic montage with three unequal substantial crops, hard overlaps and distributed edge captions. Boundaries are more diagonal and the identity heavier than the advisory plan; this does not create a copy, use-size or structural defect.

basic_style_exclusion.observation: Photographic actions and their cut boundaries organize the poster. Images are dominant rather than subordinate to a solid/split-color heading/information template, and no empty wall, floor or interior is used to hold the information.

format.observation: Single flat opaque landscape poster; no mockup or multi-poster panel.

use_size_reading.observation: All eleven entries were read at the specified usage view, including entry time, purchasing condition, public participation and cup reminder.

hangul.observation: Visible syllable blocks, counters and word spacing are legible and consistent; no ambiguous required Hangul was observed.

information_relationship.observation: Identity/time and adjacent venue, purchase, participation, cup and invitation stops are distributed along the relevant photographs and can be found through their edges.

function_contact.observation: Serving contact and guitar anatomy are visibly coherent. No requested phone, URL, logo or exact client identity is applicable.

material_edge_finish.observation: Clean opaque native finish and intentional hard image boundaries; no obvious local compositing defect was observed.

real_promotion.observation: No identifiable business, performer name, visible commercial logo, watermark, QR or pseudo-print was observed.

decision.reason: The initial returned montage communicates the shared neighborhood evening and all required copy is readable at usage720. No observed copy/condition/use-size or obvious structural defect justifies a native repair.
